summary_en: 180,000 shares (1.53% of shares outstanding) to be acquired on 2026-08-24 via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥5,810/share; ¥1,045.8M total commitment; all acquired shares to be cancelled on 2026-08-31.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock, Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3), and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-21, Nippon Beet Sugar Manufacturing resolved by board decision to acquire up to 180,000 treasury shares and to cancel all shares so acquired. The acquisition will take place on 2026-08-24 via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of ¥5,810/share (final special quote inclusive), with a total commitment ceiling of ¥1,045.8M. The order is limited to that single trading session. All 180,000 shares acquired are scheduled for cancellation effective 2026-08-31. The stated reason is to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. As of 2026-07-31, the company held 722,029 treasury shares against 11,765,560 shares outstanding (excluding treasury); the proposed acquisition represents 1.53% of the ex-treasury share count.
